The model generates answers to questions in various languages by retrieving relevant passages and using a reader to produce the final answer text.

We compare QA results with multilingual models that use BM25 for monolingual retrieval, translate-test models MT+DPR, GMT+GS, MT+Mono and ReAtt+MT , and multilingual fusion-in-decoder models CORA, Sentri and LAPCA using F1, exact match (EM) and BLEU scores.
